identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
principles: No decorative gradients. Color denotes function only.
Typography is the UI. Size and weight define hierarchy.
Borders over Shadows. Define edges with 1px strokes, not blurry drop shadows.
Density control. High density for data, high breathing room for reading.

instructions_to_main_agent: UPDATE /app/frontend/src/index.css: Replace the @layer base :root and .dark variables with the 'colors.css_variables' values provided above.
ADD FONTS: Add the @import for JetBrains Mono and Inter to the top of /app/frontend/src/index.css.
APPLY FONTS: Update the 'body' rule in index.css to use 'Inter' as default, and create utility classes for 'font-mono' using 'JetBrains Mono'.
MARKETING/HOME PAGE: Do not use a generic centered layout. Use a 'Bento Grid' layout. Left column (Documentation List) takes 4 cols, Right column (Chat/Upload) takes 8 cols.
UPLOAD COMPONENT: Make the drag-and-drop area large (h-64) with a dashed border that turns solid primary on hover. Use a large icon.

CHAT INTERFACE: The input bar should be at the bottom, sticky. The chat history should flow upwards. Use bubbles but keep them minimal (no heavy colors). User: Dark Grey bubble. AI: Transparent with left border line.
STATUS PAGE: Use a dense grid. Each status (DB, Backend, LLM) should be a small card with a glowing dot indicator.
ICONS: Use 'lucide-react' for all icons. Keep stroke width at 1.5px or 2px max for consistency.
TESTING: Ensure every button and input has a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'upload-btn', 'query-input').
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors or subtle noise patterns if absolutely necessary.
Avoid 'center-everything'. Use asymmetry to create visual interest.
Ensure all text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against its background.
Use 2x more padding than you think is necessary. Whitespace is a feature.
Never use generic 'AI' emojis (robot, brain, sparkles) in the UI. Use abstract geometric icons instead.
